Admin-only tool!|lf DO NOT USE UNLESS YOU HAVE A WORLD BACKUP|lf- Allows changing entire chunks between alternate versions|lf  or importing the biomes to chunks from alternate versions|lf- Left/right click to set area corners|lf- Ctrl + scroll: Change mode|lf- Alt + scroll: Change target world|lf- (Alt +) Shift + scroll: Move area corners|lf- Alt + toggle: Add current selection to "stored" selection|lf- Shift + toggle: Remove current selection from "stored" selection|lf- Ctrl + Alt + toggle: Clear "stored" selection|lf- Ctrl + Shift + Alt + toggle: Clear the changed chunks exporter data|lf- Toggle key alone: Execute the selected action
